_comment: Off-balance-sheet items read from filing TEXT (lease, VIE, commitments, guarantees and equity-method notes), one record per item. XBRL-tagged items (RPO, purchase obligations, VIE maximum exposure, guarantees, equity-method investments) come from the automated feed and are not repeated here. Each record: ticker, item (leases_not_commenced | vie_unconsolidated | vie_consolidated | jv_equity_method_debt | spv | rvg | take_or_pay | guarantee | purchase_obligation | prepayment), amountUSDm (null when the filing gives none), basis (undiscounted | present_value | max_exposure | notional | carrying), asOf, filing {form, accn, url, section, page}, quote (the sentence the figure comes from), commence (for leases: from/to), counterparty, lookthrough {sharePct, amountUSDm, method} when a proportional view applies, accounting (ASC topic), tier T1, status needs_review | verified, verifiedBy, verifiedOn. Items may carry subsequent: true (signed after the balance-sheet date; never added to that date's totals), includedIn (already counted in another item) and note_en/note_es. Searched results: none (looked for and absent) or amount_not_disclosed (exists, no amount). Text-derived numbers stay needs_review until a second reading of the cited page confirms them (the automated second read or the owner). Oracle's items are read from the Oracle model's verified store (tools/oracle/data/obligations.json) by scripts/hyperscalers/build.mjs and are not duplicated here. reviewedBy: a person's sign-off (name and date); null until an analyst reviews the item. Verification = automated quote-match plus a second automated read, never an analyst review. build.mjs checks every quote against the harvested page of the cited accession (quoteCheck), links the main filing document and records its filed date; readBy/verifiedBy are internal provenance and are not emitted to the site. press: dated press reports (T3) about structures a filing has not yet carried (a venture's project bond, a reported chip-leasing vehicle); shown in their own section and in the related item's card, entering no figure. asOfKind 'subsequent_event' with asOfLabel_*: the item is an increment disclosed after the balance-sheet date, not a balance; basisNote_* explains what it is and is not added to.

press.title_en: Meta's Louisiana venture (Hyperion; issuer "Beignet"): the US$27.3 bn 144A project bond, 6.581% due 2049, traded near 91 cents on the dollar on 7 Oct 2026, a record low
press.title_es: Coinversión de Meta en Luisiana (Hyperion; emisor «Beignet»): el bono de proyecto 144A de US$27.3 mil M, 6.581% con vencimiento en 2049, se negoció cerca de 91 centavos por dólar el 7 oct 2026, un mínimo histórico
press.memo_en: Per the press, the venture that builds Meta's Hyperion campus in Louisiana (the 20% equity-method venture in Meta's 10-Q, maximum exposure US$46.03 bn, with Meta's residual value guarantees of about US$28 bn) placed US$27.3 bn of senior secured notes, 6.581% due 2049, in a private (144A) offering in late 2025; the notes fell to a record low near 91 cents on the dollar on 7 Oct 2026 (about 91.6 cents per one report). The bond is the venture's debt, not Meta's: it is not in Meta's balance sheet, its amount is not stated in Meta's filing (the look-through column stays "not disclosed"), and the price is a market reading that enters no figure on this hub.
press.memo_es: Según la prensa, la coinversión que construye el campus Hyperion de Meta en Luisiana (la coinversión al 20% por método de participación del 10-Q de Meta, exposición máxima de US$46.03 mil M, con garantías de valor residual de Meta por unos US$28 mil M) colocó US$27.3 mil M de notas senior garantizadas, 6.581% con vencimiento en 2049, en una oferta privada (144A) a fines de 2025; las notas cayeron a un mínimo histórico cercano a 91 centavos por dólar el 7 oct 2026 (unos 91.6 centavos según un reporte). El bono es deuda de la coinversión, no de Meta: no está en el balance de Meta, su monto no aparece en la presentación de Meta (la columna proporcional sigue en «no revelado») y el precio es una lectura de mercado que no entra en ninguna cifra de este centro.

press.title_en: Oracle in early-stage talks with Apollo and Goldman Sachs on a vehicle that would buy about 1 GW of AI chips and lease them to Oracle (WSJ, 7 Oct 2026; size not disclosed)
press.title_es: Oracle, en pláticas iniciales con Apollo y Goldman Sachs sobre un vehículo que compraría cerca de 1 GW de chips de IA y se los arrendaría (WSJ, 7 oct 2026; monto no revelado)
press.memo_en: The Wall Street Journal reported on the evening of 7 Oct 2026 (relayed by Yahoo Finance on 7 and 8 Oct) that Oracle is in talks with Apollo Global Management and Goldman Sachs to finance a large purchase of AI chips for a roughly 1-gigawatt data center through a separate company that would own the chips and lease them to Oracle over time, that other partners are also in talks and that Oracle wants a deal this year; no amount was reported and Oracle has not commented or filed anything. If signed, the chips would reach Oracle as a lease: under ASC 842 the liability and the right-of-use asset come onto the balance sheet at commencement (finance or operating by the lease's terms), not as notes payable, so the structure would show in the lease-adjusted view and in lease-adjusted leverage, and among the lease commitments not yet commenced once signed. The same memo sits on this site's Oracle page; it enters no figure.
press.memo_es: The Wall Street Journal reportó la noche del 7 oct 2026 (retomado por Yahoo Finance el 7 y el 8 oct) que Oracle negocia con Apollo Global Management y Goldman Sachs el financiamiento de una compra grande de chips de IA para un centro de datos de cerca de 1 gigavatio a través de una sociedad aparte que sería dueña de los chips y se los arrendaría a Oracle a lo largo del tiempo, que también habla con otros socios y que quiere cerrar este año; no se reportó monto y Oracle no ha comentado ni presentado nada. De firmarse, los chips llegarían a Oracle como arrendamiento: bajo ASC 842 el pasivo y el activo por derecho de uso entran al balance al inicio (financiero u operativo según los términos), no como notas por pagar, así que la estructura aparecería en la vista ajustada por arrendamientos y en el apalancamiento ajustado, y entre los compromisos de arrendamiento no iniciados una vez firmado. El mismo memo está en la página de Oracle de este sitio; no entra en ninguna cifra.
